items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] -- everybody know who Sco-be-o-De is, he's the little friend of Louis who wrote "I'll be Glad when You're Dead, You Rascal You" for Louie. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: and took him back to St. Louis where he was working in the Plantation there and says, "You quit when we tell you you can quit. You don't leave us."
-- everybody know who Sco-be-o-De is, he's the little friend of Louis who wrote "I'll be Glad when You're Dead, You Rascal You" for Louie.
